supporting_observations.claim: The large outbound transfer is associated with the approved Cloudkeep agent running as svc-arch on FILE-BLU-01; the recorded command targets ingest.cloudkeep-backup.com.

The transfer matches the approved offsite-backup service: the proxy records a 640,000,000-byte client-to-server tunnel to ingest.cloudkeep-backup.com, and Zeek records approximately the same outbound volume.

The process, service account, destination, and transfer size align with the organization's stated Cloudkeep backup profile, which includes uploads of several hundred MB; the available evidence therefore supports a benign disposition for the alerted activity.

known_telemetry_limitations: The transfer records provide destination and byte counts, not the files or data contents sent; the proxy's inspected GET is a separate small request, while the large transfer is recorded as a tunnel. (T200-00249, T200-00253, T200-00255)
The supplied records do not include a Cloudkeep backup manifest or job history to independently confirm which files were included. (T200-00246, T200-00253, T200-00255)
claims_not_established: The specific files or data included in the transfer.
Whether the Cloudkeep job's timing and transferred contents were expected for this particular run.
unrelated_findings: Ruth Moss launched mstsc to FILE-BLU-01 and established an RDP session, although the supplied environment context says remote administration is only done from WS-KITO-01. Treat this as a separate review; it does not change the disposition of the Cloudkeep transfer. (T200-00273, T200-00277, T200-00280, T200-00282)
